question: When does offered betel leaf become ritually unusable as nirmālya?
premises: Betel leaf is mentioned as an offering.
A time limit of half a month is stated.
The condition is linked to its having been given.
inference: Betel leaf becomes nirmālya half a month after being offered.
uncertainties: The exact force of datta-mātrataḥ is slightly ambiguous.
plain_english: O great goddess, betel leaf becomes offered remains after half a month from the time it is given.
